lines.japanese: しかし学園生活も残り三ヶ月だってのに、こんなに遊んでていいのかな俺。
lines.english: Only three months remained of my school life. Was it really okay for me to spend this much time screwing around?

lines.japanese: 期末も終わって試験は残ってないけど、学生の本分は学業。少しは勉学に勤しんだ方がいいかもしれない。
lines.english: Final exams were over and no tests remained, but a student's first duty was to study. Maybe I ought to apply myself a little.

lines.japanese: よし、今日は帰ったら勉強しよう。学生らしい生活を送って毎日のリズムを整えれば、人格を安定させる一助になるかもしれない。
lines.english: All right. I'd study when I got home today. If I lived like a proper student and put my daily rhythm in order, maybe it would help stabilize my personality.

lines.japanese: 「たっだいまー！」
lines.english: “I'm hoooome!”

lines.japanese: しーん……。
lines.english: Not a sound...

lines.japanese: 残念ながら俺のことを出迎えてくれるひとはいなかった。小鳩はまだ帰ってないのかな。
lines.english: Sadly, nobody came to greet me. Was Kobato not home yet?

lines.japanese: 腹も減ったし、なにかつまんでから部屋に戻るか……。
lines.english: I was hungry too. Maybe I'd grab a bite before going to my room...

lines.japanese: 「おかえりなサイ、ドラ」
lines.english: “Welcome back, yak, Drac.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 三歩下がって二歩進んだ。もちろんその途中、何度か周りを見渡した。
lines.english: I took three steps back and two steps forward. Naturally, I looked around several times in between.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？　ずいぶん見た目変わったけど、どうしたんだ小鳩。まるで別人じゃないか」
lines.english: “H-huh? You look awfully different, Kobato. What happened? You're practically another person.”

lines.japanese: 「髪がずいぶん長くなったけど、なんだこれ？　エクステンョンってやつか？」
lines.english: “And your hair got so long. What is that, one of those exten-shuns?”

lines.japanese: 「いいえ、これはツインテールと呼ばれます。ジャパニーズ・サブカルチャー」
lines.english: “No. They're called pigtails. Japanese pop culture.”

lines.japanese: 「それになんだその髪の色は。校則違反じゃないのか」
lines.english: “And what happened to your hair color? Doesn’t that violate school rules?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことはありません。私は学校において堂々としている」
lines.english: “Certainly not. At school, I stand openly and proudly.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなのか……ところで日本語が下手になったな」
lines.english: “I see... Your Japanese has gotten worse, by the way.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、その事実に私は少なからず衝撃を受けた」
lines.english: “Th-that fact has dealt me no small shock.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああゴメン。今のは直球すぎた、悪かった」
lines.english: “Oh. Sorry. That was too direct. My fault.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよお兄ちゃん、アリスちゃんがんばってるんだよ」
lines.english: “That’s right, Big Brother. Alice is trying very hard.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 居間に入ってきたのは、ストローがささったオレンジ色をお盆に載せて運んできた本物の妹だった。
lines.english: Then my real sister came into the living room, carrying a tray with two glasses of orange liquid, a straw in each.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ダメッ」
lines.english: “No, don’t!”

lines.japanese: その二つのコップの片方を取ろうとしたら、手が届く前に小鳩に避けられた。
lines.english: I reached for one of the glasses, but Kobato whisked it away before I could reach it.

lines.japanese: 「もうちょっと早く帰ってきてくれたら、お兄ちゃんの分も用意したのに」
lines.english: “If you’d come home a little earlier, I would’ve prepared one for you too.”

lines.japanese: 「てことはこれは誰の分なんだ」
lines.english: “Then who are these for?”

lines.japanese: 「だから私と」
lines.english: “Mine, and...”

lines.japanese: 「私のジュースだ」
lines.english: “My juice.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、もしかしてうちに遊びに来たの？」
lines.english: “Wait. Did you come over to visit?”

lines.japanese: 「おそすぎる」
lines.english: “You're far too slow.”

lines.japanese: 「おじゃましてマス」
lines.english: “I am intruding.”

lines.japanese: 金髪の少女はスカートをちょんとつまんで頭を下げた。
lines.english: The blond girl delicately pinched her skirt and bowed.

lines.japanese: 参ったな、俺いま制服なんだけど……まあアリスだしいっか。
lines.english: Damn. I was still in my uniform... Well, it was only Alice. Probably fine.

lines.japanese: 「おいでませ羽田邸」
lines.english: “Y’all come on in to the Haneda homestead!”

lines.japanese: 「おいでま……」
lines.english: “Y’all come—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、いらっしゃい」
lines.english: “A-ah. I mean, welcome.”

lines.japanese: アリス相手には迂闊に方言ギャグも使えないや。気をつけないと。
lines.english: I couldn't risk dialect jokes around Alice. I would have to be careful.

lines.japanese: 「で、二人でなにしてたの」
lines.english: “So what were you two doing?”

lines.japanese: 「アリスちゃんに日本語の勉強」
lines.english: “Studying Japanese with Alice.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ……え、小鳩が先生？」
lines.english: “Huh... Wait. You're the teacher?”

lines.japanese: 「すごいでしょー」
lines.english: “Amazing, right?”

lines.japanese: 「凄いっていうか……」
lines.english: “Amazing, or...”

lines.japanese: 大丈夫？
lines.english: Was that really safe?

lines.japanese: とは思ったが、小鳩が小さい体を反らして得意げな顔をしてるから、深入りするのはやめておいた。
lines.english: That was what I thought, but Kobato drew herself up, small as she was, with such a proud look that I let the matter drop.

lines.japanese: 「で、成果は？」
lines.english: “And the results?”

lines.japanese: 代わりにアリスの方に質問をした。
lines.english: Instead, I asked Alice.

lines.japanese: 「せーか……」
lines.english: “Results...”

lines.japanese: 「はい、ばっちりだ。私はますますしゃべれるようになる」
lines.english: “Yes. Perfect. I become increasingly able to speak.”

lines.japanese: 「さっそく怪しいんだけど、じゃあ幾つか質問するぞ」
lines.english: “Already sounds dubious. All right, I'll ask you a few questions.”

lines.japanese: 「どんとこい」
lines.english: “Bring it on.”

lines.japanese: アリスがハートの付いたネクタイをぱんと叩いた。そういう仕草だけはいっちょまえだ。
lines.english: Alice gave the heart on her tie a confident slap. At least she had the gesture down.

lines.japanese: 「あなたにはいま欲しいものがありますか」
lines.english: “Is there anything you want right now?”

lines.japanese: 「オレンジジュース」
lines.english: “Orange juice.”

lines.japanese: 「いやそれバリ英語」
lines.english: “That’s straight-up English!”

lines.japanese: 「おかわり」
lines.english: “A refill.”

lines.japanese: 「やかましいわ」
lines.english: Shut up.

lines.japanese: 「さあ次々来るがいい」
lines.english: “Come. Let the next ones come one after another.”

lines.japanese: アリスが腰に手を当てて得意そうな顔をした。
lines.english: Alice planted her hands upon her hips and looked proud.

lines.japanese: もう間違ってる気もするが、どうしても答えたいようなので続けてやることにした。
lines.english: I had a feeling that was wrong too, but she clearly wanted to keep answering, so I went on.

lines.japanese: 「分かった、じゃあ次いくぞ。今日の夕飯はなにが食べたいですか」
lines.english: “Fine. Next question. What would you like for dinner tonight?”

lines.japanese: 「カレーライス」
lines.english: “Curry rice.”

lines.japanese: 「それも八割方英語だろうが」
lines.english: “That's eighty percent English too!”

lines.japanese: 「帰ってくる途中に話して、買いものしてきたよ」
lines.english: “We talked about it on the way home and bought the ingredients.”

lines.japanese: 「しかも事前に予習済みじゃねーか。話にならねえよ」
lines.english: And you studied it beforehand! This is ridiculous.

lines.japanese: 「玉ねぎは嫌いだから入れないでください」
lines.english: “I dislike onions, so please do not include them.”

lines.japanese: 「我がままぬかすな、おまえのカレーには玉ねぎ敷きつめてやるからたんと食え」
lines.english: “Don't be selfish. I'll carpet your curry with onions and you can eat your fill.”

lines.japanese: ていうかツッコミに忙殺されたけど、今の日本語上手かった。
lines.english: I had been too busy firing back at her to notice, but that last bit was excellent Japanese.

lines.japanese: 「さあ、その程度で最終ですか」
lines.english: “Come. Is that the highest level you possess?”

lines.japanese: そして今度は間違えてる。でも問題だけは出してほしいみたいだ。仕方ないからもう一度だけ付きあってあげることにした。
lines.english: And now she was wrong again. Apparently all she really wanted was more questions. Fine. I decided to humor her just once more.

lines.japanese: 「よかったら今日泊まっていけば」
lines.english: “Why don't you stay the night?”

lines.japanese: 「Ｒｅａｌｌｙ？　Ｔｈａｎｋｓ，Ｄｏｒａ！」
lines.english: “Really? Thanks, Drac!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「しゃべれよ！　日本語を！」
lines.english: “SPEAK JAPANESE!”

lines.japanese: 俺はクラシカルなジャパニーズツッコミを叩きこんだ。
lines.english: I delivered a classic Japanese straight-man retort.

lines.japanese: 「まあそう熱くなるな」
lines.english: “Easy, don’t get so worked up.”

lines.japanese: しかしやつはよしよしと冷静に俺の手を払いのけた。
lines.english: But she calmly brushed my hand aside, as if to say, There, there.

lines.japanese: 「わっ、アリスちゃん、いまのは上手だったよ。やったね！」
lines.english: “Wow, Alice! That one was really good! You did it!”

lines.japanese: 「アリス、おまえ絶対分かっててやってるだろ」
lines.english: “Alice, you know exactly what you're doing, don't you?”

lines.japanese: しかしアリスは頑として首を縦に振らなかった。
lines.english: Alice steadfastly refused to nod.

lines.japanese: 玉ねぎの食べすぎで頭の中がネギの臭いに侵されていた。
lines.english: I’d eaten so many onions I could smell them inside my head.

lines.japanese: 小鳩の作ったカレーはおいしかった。おいしかったけど、いかんせん玉ねぎの量が多かった。
lines.english: Kobato's curry had been delicious. Delicious, yes, but there had simply been too many onions.

lines.japanese: 俺が横になって腹をさすっていると、フロ上がりのアリスがてててと近づいてきた。
lines.english: As I lay there rubbing my stomach, Alice came pattering over, fresh from the bath.

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、よく食べました。よくがんばりました。なのにあなたは苦しいのですか」
lines.english: “Drac, you ate well. You tried very hard. And yet you suffer?”

lines.japanese: おまえがひとのカレーにばんばん玉ねぎブチ込んでくるからだ。
lines.english: Because you kept dumping onions into my curry.

lines.japanese: と思ったけど俺は大人だからネギ臭い息を吐きかけるだけで許してやった。
lines.english: That was what I thought, but I was an adult, so I forgave her with nothing worse than a blast of onion breath in her face.

lines.japanese: 「おフロ気持ちよかったよ。お兄ちゃんも入ってきなよ」
lines.english: “The bath felt wonderful. You should go in too, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう。じゃあ入ってこようかな」
lines.english: “Oh, okay. Guess I’ll go take one, then.”

lines.japanese: 俺は自分の部屋に着替えを取りにいこうとして、ふと足を止めた。
lines.english: I started toward my room for a change of clothes, then stopped.

lines.japanese: 「ああそうだ、泊まっていけって言ったのは俺だけど、自分でちゃんと保護者に連絡いれておけよ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. I'm the one who invited you to stay, but make sure you call your guardian yourself.”

lines.japanese: ほこほこと赤い顔でテレビを見ている外国人に、びしっと指を突きつけた。
lines.english: I thrust a stern finger at the foreign girl watching television, her face warm and rosy from the bath.

lines.japanese: 「あ、それじゃうちの電話使っていいよ」
lines.english: “Oh, then go ahead and use our phone.”

lines.japanese: 「おそれはいります」
lines.english: “Fear enters me.”

lines.japanese: 「あとそのまま寝るわけにもいかないだろうから、小鳩の寝巻きを貸してあげなさい」
lines.english: “And you can't very well sleep like that. Kobato, lend her some pajamas.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん」
lines.english: “Oh. Okay.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか小鳩も寝巻きを着なさい」
lines.english: “Actually, Kobato, you put on pajamas too.”

lines.japanese: 「おそれはいります」
lines.english: “Fear enters me.”

lines.japanese: さて、それじゃ入るか。
lines.english: Right. Time for my bath.

lines.japanese: 二人に言いつけを残して、俺はフロ場に向かった。
lines.english: Leaving the two of them with those instructions, I headed for the bathroom.

lines.japanese: あー、気持ちよかった。
lines.english: Ah, that felt wonderful.

lines.japanese: 冬のフロは最高だった。俺は部屋に戻ってすでに布団にくるまっていた。
lines.english: Winter baths were the best. I had already returned to my room and burrowed under the covers.

lines.japanese: 小鳩の部屋から話し声が聞こえたので声をかけようかとも思ったけど、女の子同士で楽しんでるとこに水をさすのもなんだしね。さすが俺、優しいお兄ちゃん。
lines.english: I heard voices from Kobato's room and thought about calling to them, but I shouldn't spoil two girls having fun together. God, what a considerate big brother I was.

lines.japanese: 自己満足に浸った俺は、適当に掲示板をいつもの順番で巡回して、適当に明日の準備をして、適当な時間に寝た。
lines.english: Basking in my own virtue, I made a halfhearted circuit of my usual message boards in the usual order, made a halfhearted effort to prepare for tomorrow, and went to sleep at some random hour.

lines.japanese: おやすみなさい。
lines.english: Good night.

lines.japanese: ぐう。
lines.english: Snore.

lines.japanese: 「で、でも起こしちゃったら悪いよう。やっぱり止めようよ」
lines.english: “B-but we'd feel awful if we woke him. Let's not do this after all.”

lines.japanese: 「ならば小鳩は部屋に戻るといい。ドラは私のものです」
lines.english: “Then Kobato may return to her room. Drac is mine.”

lines.japanese: 「むー、それはダメ。起きないといいなあ……」
lines.english: “Hmph. That's not allowed. I hope he doesn't wake up...”

lines.japanese: もぞもぞ
lines.english: Rustle, rustle.

lines.japanese: あれ？　もう朝か？　また起こしにきてくれたのかなあ……。
lines.english: Huh? Was it morning already? Had she come to wake me again...?

lines.japanese: でも外はまだ暗い気がするんだけど……気のせいかな。
lines.english: It still felt dark outside, though... Was I imagining that?

lines.japanese: 「先手必勝、これ言います。日本では花見のときに行われるポジショニング」
lines.english: First move wins, this is said. In Japan, it is positioning done at cherry-blossom viewing.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あーっ！　じゃあ私こっちー！」
lines.english: “Ah! Then I'm taking this side!”

lines.japanese: もぞもぞ
lines.english: Rustle, rustle.

lines.japanese: あれ、なんか温かいものが入ってきた……寒いからいいけど……。
lines.english: Huh? Something warm had gotten in... It was cold, so I didn't mind...

lines.japanese: ていうか巻きついてきた……しかも挟みこむように……まるで誰かがふとんに入ってきたみたいだ……。
lines.english: Wait, it had wrapped itself around me... and enclosed me from both sides... almost as if somebody had climbed under the covers...

lines.japanese: な、なんだろうこの柔らかい感触は……まさか誰かふとんに入ってきたわけじゃないよな……。
lines.english: Wh-what was this softness...? Surely nobody had actually climbed in beside me...

lines.japanese: ちょ、ちょっとだけ薄目を開けてみよう……。
lines.english: I-I’ll open my eyes the tiniest amount...

lines.japanese: <8>\　ええええええっ！！
lines.english: Whaaaaaat!?

lines.japanese: 半ば予想できていたとはいえ、あまりの光景に形而上のふとんがふっとんだ。
lines.english: Though I had half expected it, the spectacle blows away even the metaphysical futon.

lines.japanese: 「この部屋は寒いです。人肌が温かい」
lines.english: “This room is cold. Human skin is warm.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、温かいね……お兄ちゃんと寝るなんていつ以来だろ……あ、あはー」
lines.english: “Y-yes, it is... How long has it been since I slept beside you, Big Brother...? Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: いつ以来だろう。おそらく幼稚園以来だったと思う。
lines.english: How long indeed? Probably not since kindergarten.

lines.japanese: あの頃はなにも思わなかったのに、今ではこんなに大きくなって……もう小鳩じゃなくて鳩だ。立派な鳩だ。
lines.english: Back then, I thought nothing of it. Now she has grown so much... She is no little dove any longer, but a full-fledged one.

lines.japanese: って、なにを言ってるんだ小鳩とアリスだぞ。こんな体の小さい二人になにを考えて……。
lines.english: What am I saying? These are Kobato and Alice. They are both so small—what am I even thinking?

lines.japanese: 「ドラの手、大きい」
lines.english: “Drac’s hand is large.”

lines.japanese: むにゅっ
lines.english: Press.

lines.japanese: <8>\　おおおおおおっ！！
lines.english: Ooooooh!?

lines.japanese: 俺の手が明らかに肉のそれと分かる質感に挟まれ……は、挟まれた！？
lines.english: My hand is abruptly caught against unmistakably human softness—c-caught!?

lines.japanese: ど、どこ触った！？　いま俺の手はどこ触った！
lines.english: Wh-where did I touch? What is my hand touching now?

lines.japanese: この細っこい身体のアリスの質感を感じられる箇所っていうと、位置的にも……い、いやだから俺はそういうんじゃなくて……。
lines.english: Given Alice’s slight frame, there are few possible places with that texture, especially at this position... N-no, that is not what I mean...

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんの腕、昔は届かなかったのにな……」
lines.english: “Your arm never reached this far when we were little...”

lines.japanese: むぎゅっ
lines.english: Squeeze.

lines.japanese: <8>\　いいいいいいっ！？
lines.english: Eeeeeek!?

lines.japanese: アリスより明らかに女を感じる肉感が腕に押しつけられ……お、押しつけっ！？
lines.english: A distinctly feminine softness presses against my arm—p-presses!?

lines.japanese: な、なんだ、なにを押しつけられたんだ俺の腕っ！？
lines.english: Wh-what is being pressed against my arm!?

lines.japanese: がっちりと固定された腕は小鳩の中心線にまっすぐ密着していた。
lines.english: My firmly trapped arm lies directly against the center of Kobato’s body.

lines.japanese: まだ未成熟な二つの膨らみの儚い質感が、俺の上腕に伝わってえも言われぬ至福の快感が押しよせてきた（混乱したマンティコアは平常時よりも凶暴さが増し、一国の軍隊など相手にもならないのです）。
lines.english: The faint texture of two still-immature swells against my upper arm sent indescribable bliss flooding through me. (A confused manticore grows even more violent than usual; the army of an entire nation is no match for it.)

lines.japanese: そして手の先に当たる場所は……。
lines.english: And where my hand has come to rest...

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、お兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “Hee hee. Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: もにゅっ
lines.english: Shift.

lines.japanese: 小鳩の足が収まりの悪そうに動くたび、俺の手がその肌に食いこんでいく。
lines.english: Each time Kobato shifted her legs uncomfortably, my hand dug deeper into her skin.

lines.japanese: ままま待て、俺は大人だ兄だ健常人だ、こんなことで理性を失うわけにはいかん。
lines.english: W-w-wait. I am an adult, a brother, a sane person. I cannot lose my reason over this.

lines.japanese: それも二人に挟まれた状態でそんなおまえ、ねえ？
lines.english: Especially not while I’m wedged between the two of them like this. I mean, come on, right?

lines.japanese: 徐々に硬直していく手の筋肉は、触覚をさらに鋭敏なものにした。
lines.english: The muscles of my hand stiffen, sharpening every sensation further.

lines.japanese: 「ドラ。ドラは私の」
lines.english: “Drac. Drac is mine.”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、戻ってきてくれてありがとう……」
lines.english: “Big Brother, thank you for coming back...”

lines.japanese: もにゅにゅむぎゅっ
lines.english: Press, squeeze.

lines.japanese: <8>\　ああああああっ！！
lines.english: Aaaaaaah!?

lines.japanese: いやいやいやこれ俺が悪いか？　悪いのか？　ここで錯乱したとして俺が悪いんか？
lines.english: No, no, no. Is this my fault? Is it? If I lose my mind here, is that really my fault?

lines.japanese: だっておっぱい腕に当たってんだもん。こんなもん我慢しろって方がムリだっつの。しかも両側からムギューって。
lines.english: Because their boobs are pressed against my arms, that’s why! How am I supposed to hold back like this? And they’re squeezing me from both sides!
